summary: Approved iteration `welcome-email`. Source review found the implementation satisfies the iteration objective: Gmail configuration is read server-side from `GMAIL_USER`, `GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD`, and `GMAIL_FROM`; welcome email sending is server-only and injectable; Auth.js triggers delivery from `events.createUser` only after persisted new-user creation; duplicate sends are avoided through persisted `welcomeEmailAttemptedAt` claiming; failures are caught, audited, sanitized, and do not roll back registration. Fresh non-browser checks passed: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`, `npx.cmd prisma validate`, `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`, `node --test .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\registration-profile-consent-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-email-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-delivery-behavior.test.mjs` with 13/13 passing, and `npm.cmd run lint`. Per instruction and recorded process decision, production build was not run for this iteration review. Browser verification, Playwright, app server startup, deployment, publishing, and real Gmail delivery were not run and are not claimed as passed.
